== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Death Star: Docking Bay 327]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-premiere-wb-ls-death-star-docking-bay-327/ SWCCGcards], [https://swccgcards.com/wp-content/uploads/2022/01/jpn_premiere_wb_ls_DEATH_STAR_DOCKING_BAY_327.png source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(8, 6, 843, 1194)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>b5236f0dd99571f616143315fed47dd7521d89732b1f6fa09273cb0804cf3417</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
